selected_script.angle: DIY baking soda paste just creates a crusty mess on gas stovetop grease; Liapu spray dissolves the thick oil splatter immediately for a one-wipe clean.
selected_script.hook: I tried that baking soda hack on my greasy stovetop and it just made a crusty mess.

script_record.segment_01: I tried that baking soda hack on my greasy stovetop and it just made a crusty mess. Then I found this Liapu spray.
script_record.segment_02: You literally just spray it on the oil splatter, let it sit for a few seconds, and wipe. It breaks down the heavy grease instantly.
script_record.segment_03: No weird residue, just a fresh lemon scent. Plus it kills 99.9% of kitchen bacteria like Salmonella. This is a total game changer.
